newsitem.title: GERMANY: German DAX ends bourse trade flat, futures support.
newsitem.headline: German DAX ends bourse trade flat, futures support.

text.p: German shares ended largely flat in bourse trade on Wednesday as a rise in the DAX futures market provided some insulation from overnight losses on Wall Street.
The DAX-30 index of leading German shares closed 1.41 points up at 3,397.36, with June DAX futures reversing late Wednesday losses to trade 31 points up at 3,401.0.
"It's mainly down to the rise in futures, which in turn was a bit surprising," said one dealer, adding that a firmer dollar at just under 1.72 marks was also helping trade.

With little corporate news or economic data scheduled, dealers expected trade to be range-bound for the rest of the day. German state inflation data coming through on Thursday morning had little market impact.
Volumes were dominated by Germany's top three banks, with Deutsche Bank up 80 pfennigs at 90.85, Dresdner up 10 pfennigs at 55.30 and Commerzbank up 60 pfennigs at 46.90.
Carbon and graphite producer SGL Carbon closed 8.90 marks higher at 245 marks as U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch said it was initiating coverage in the stock as a buy.
